data.name: FLUX 3 Image
data.description: FLUX 3 text-to-image generation and instruction-based image editing, with up to ten references and prompt-based bounding-box layouts.

data.name: FLUX 3 Image Klein
data.description: Fast FLUX 3 image generation and editing with up to ten references, automatic prompt upsampling, and seed, step, and output-format controls.

data.name: FLUX Video Edit [fast]
data.description: Edit an existing video using a written instruction. Accepts URL or base64 source clips up to 15 seconds; timing, framing, and audio follow the source unless edited.

data.name: FLUX Video Upscale
data.description: Upscale video in precise or creative mode by 1.5 to 3 times while retaining source audio. Accepts URL or base64 source clips up to 20 seconds and 2K resolution.

data.name: FLUX 3 Video
data.description: Default FLUX 3 video model with synchronized audio. Automatically selects text-to-video, image-to-video keyframes, or video continuation from the supplied inputs.

data.name: FLUX 3 Video Draft Enhance
data.description: Renders a full-quality FLUX 3 video from the encrypted draft_cache bundle returned by a prior draft generation.

data.name: FLUX.2 [max]
data.description: Highest-quality FLUX.2 model for image generation and editing, with the strongest editing consistency and prompt following.

data.name: FLUX.2 [pro]
data.description: Recommended default FLUX.2 model for image generation and editing.

data.name: FLUX.2 [pro] (preview)
data.description: Preview endpoint for the latest FLUX.2 [pro] quality and speed improvements.

data.name: FLUX.2 [flex]
data.description: Specialized FLUX.2 model for typography, text rendering, and preserving small details.

data.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B
data.description: Fast FLUX.2 model balancing image quality and speed.

data.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 9B (preview)
data.description: Preview endpoint for the latest FLUX.2 [klein] 9B improvements.

data.name: FLUX.2 [klein] 4B
data.description: Fastest and most lightweight FLUX.2 model.

data.name: Outpaint or extend an image
data.description: The input image is placed on a (width, height) canvas at the given offset, and the surrounding region is generated by a FLUX outpainting model.

data.name: Erase an object from an image
Remove blur from an image
data.description: The input image is regenerated by a FLUX blur-removal model to sharpen it while preserving the original scene, objects, composition, and lighting.
